header.running_head: The Lectures Rasulullaah ﷺ Delivered About Dajjaal, Musaylama, Ya'jooj and Ma'jooj and Sinkings

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Khaalid bin Abdullaah bin Harmala's aunt
blocks.text: and Ma'jooj emerge. They will have broad faces, tiny eyes and reddish hair and they will come scampering down every hill. In fact, their faces will appear to look like shields covered with hide."[^1]

Hadhrat Baqeera (RA) who was the wife of Hadhrat Qa'qaa (RA) says, "I was sitting in the rows of the women when I heard Rasulullaah ﷺ deliver a lecture. Pointing with his left hand, Rasulullaah ﷺ said, 'O people! When you hear of the earth sinking in that direction (the west), then Qiyaamah has arrived.'"[^2]

Hadhrat Baraa (RA) narrates that Rasulullaah ﷺ once delivered a lecture (in such a high pitch) that even the young ladies sitting in seclusion in the inner rooms of their homes could hear him. Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "O assembly of those who have accepted Imaan with their tongues without it entering their hearts! Never backbite about the Muslims and never search for their faults because Allaah will search for the faults of the person who searches for the faults of his brother. Remember that when Allaah searches for the faults of a person, he will be humiliated while sitting in the inner recesses of his home."[^3]

Another narration states that Rasulullaah ﷺ added, "Never harm the Mu'mineen, and never search for their faults because Allaah will expose the faults of the person who searches for the faults of his brother."[^4]
The Lecture Rasulullaah ﷺ Delivered about Enjoining Good and Forbidding Evil

Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) said, "Rasulullaah ﷺ came to my room one day and I could see from his face that something had happened. He proceeded to make wudhu and without speaking to anyone, he went to the Masjid. I pressed my ear to the wall to hear what he had to say. After sitting on the pulpit and praising Allaah, Rasulullaah ﷺ said, 'O people! Allaah says, 'Enjoin good and forbid evil before the time arrives when you pray to Me and I will not respond; you will ask from Me and I will not grant you and you will ask Me for assistance and I will not assist you." Rasulullaah ﷺ then descended from the pulpit without saying anything else."[^5]
